messages:
maria: Heads-up: opened a small PR to tighten up the model catalog migration examples and fix two outdated anchors. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/513

kevin: Thanks. Which model entry did you change?

maria: Updated polaris13b card: clarified supported quant variants, added a short "how we measured" note for the bench numbers, and provided a tiny SDK snippet that shows how to detect a GPU vs CPU execution.

ara: Can you paste the SDK snippet here so I can glance quickly?

maria: Sure:
```
# python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
r = c.generate("Summarize the migration steps", model="polaris13b:quant-int8")
print(r.text)
print("runtime:", getattr(r, "runtime", "unknown"))
if getattr(r, "runtime", "unknown") != "gpu":
    print("Executed on fallback:", r.runtime)
```

samir: Small ask: add the sequence_limit (8192) and an explicit note that very long contexts amplify CPU fallbacks' latency and cost.

maria: Added sequence_limit 8192 and a short table: GPU (med 90ms, p95 160ms), CPU fallback (med 420ms, p95 920ms) for 256-token gen. Also mentioned enabling prefix/KV cache to reduce repeat costs.

kevin: Please include a one-line migration checklist for Private deployments: check kernel versions and KMS setup before rolling the new cards.

maria: Done. Also fixed anchors: /models/polaris -> /catalog/polaris13b and updated internal cross-link to the runtime compat page.

docs-bot: PR opened by maria: #513  reviewers requested: @kevin @ara @samir

ara: Style nit: headers should be sentence case and keep the snippet single, minimal block.

maria: Updated per style guide. Will squash and request reviews once kevin and samir have looked at benches.

samir: I can proof the compat paragraph later today.

kevin: I'll review the bench methodology tomorrow morning.

maria: Thanks all. After merge I'll ping support and the Private deployment owners to propagate the migration checklist.

(END)
